summary: Iteration 102 retest + new Promote flow. Backend 27/28 pass (iter101 suite + new iter102 suite). Every retest item from iter101 passes: all 6 stale pro routes render not-found-screen and not-found-home goes back to /(tabs) (/fixa/provider no longer shows 'Provider not found'). The consumer notification filter works: center returned 93 rows over all pages, 0 pro rows. Unread count is 64 consumer vs 651 all, and the Feeds badge shows 64. The default audience still includes pro rows, and the legacy /notifications endpoint is filtered too. The Promote flow works end to end: the sofa shows promoted-{id} and manage-campaign goes to /ads/{id}. A new listing gets manage-promote, which opens a 4-tier sheet (no map tier, featured preselected). Picking basic and submitting shows the celebration, then /ads shows the new ACTIVE BASIC campaign on top. The wallet was debited exactly 30 MASS and /ads/mine has marketplace_item_id set. The shortfall path works: POST /ads premium returns 402 with insufficient_tokens/required/shortfall. In the UI the sheet shows promote-shortfall + promote-topup, which goes to /buy-tokens?currency=MASS. The /ads empty state (ads-empty-promote) and the header ads-promote button both go to /marketplace/my-listings. Layout retests pass: fixa-bookings header and card buttons on 2 rows; fixa detail location wraps; agent WhatsApp label fits; 'Active listings (8)' matches ACTIVE 8 with sold homes excluded; improve-screen is present. Quick regression passes: 5 tabs, Market segments, agent-app-pointer toast, property detail. No console errors. New problems: POST /ads does not check marketplace_item_id; the Promote sheet's main button is clipped at 375x667; minor /ads counts and status labels. No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch).

critical.issue: marketplace_item_id is not checked. The endpoint accepts ids that don't exist or that belong to another seller, and it still debits MASS (a 'nonexistent-…' id with tier=map returned 200 and debited 100 MASS). It also allows tier 'map' for a marketplace item and does not block a second active campaign for the same item (only the UI guards this). Ref: /app/backend/ads.py:315-370

minor.issue: Hard cap of to_list(200) with no pagination. Demo has 345 ads, 24 active in the DB, but the /ads header shows '17 active · 200 total'. Ref: ads.py:372-384
A cancelled campaign gets status 'expired' (cancelled_at is set), so /ads shows a user-cancelled campaign as EXPIRED. Ref: ads.py:531

ui_bugs.issue: At 375x667 the main button (promote-submit / promote-topup) is pushed below the bottom of the screen; its bounding box is y=645 with height 60, ending at 705. Only the top ~20px shows. Sheet.tsx has no ScrollView (maxHeight 92%), so on small phones users can't scroll to it. Fix: wrap the content in a ScrollView or pin the footer button.
Primary button label is cut to 'Confirm & Vi…' at 375 width.

issues: The intro text uses numberOfLines=2, which cuts off 'pause anytime from My Ad Campaigns'
The Premium tier perk is cut to 'Full-screen image/video ads show…'
Tier rows use accessibilityRole=radio with accessibilityState.selected; it should be 'checked' (no aria-checked is rendered)

action_items: ads.py POST /ads: when marketplace_item_id is set, check that the item exists, belongs to the user and is active (404/403). Reject tier 'map' for marketplace items (or require property_id). Reject with 409 if the item already has an active/paused campaign. Do all checks BEFORE svc.debit.
Sheet/PromoteSheet: make the content scrollable (ScrollView) or pin the button in a footer so promote-submit/promote-topup is fully visible at 375x667.
/ads: get header counts from a server-side count (or paginate /ads/mine); consider a 'cancelled' status instead of 'expired' for user cancels.

PromoteSheet: don't show the shortfall/top-up button until the wallet has loaded (mass is undefined, so balance falls back to 0). Remove onClose/toast from the tiers useEffect deps: the parent passes an inline onClose, so tiers are refetched on every parent render.
Minor: unlock sheet 'Confirm & Vi…' label truncation.
critical_code_review_comments: ads.py create_ad debits before any validation and has no idempotency, so a double submit or retry can charge twice (the UI busy flag helps only partly).
PromoteSheet.tsx:44 useEffect deps [item, onClose, toast]: onClose is an inline arrow in my-listings.tsx:308, which causes repeated GET /ads/tiers while the sheet is open.
PromoteSheet.tsx:47 balance = mass?.spendable ?? 0: the top-up button briefly flashes before the wallet loads.
my-listings.tsx is 600 lines, close to the 700-line limit.

success_rate.backend: 96% (27/28; the failing test is the new marketplace_item_id validation check)
success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows pass; Promote sheet button clipped at 375x667)
